## How it was checked

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (lint, format, types, tests with coverage)
- [ ] Behavior changes have tests, and a bug fix has a test that failed before the fix
- [ ] A new or changed check is described in `docs/checks.md`
- [ ] If the change can add false positives, it was run on real repositories and the result is in the PR
- [ ] README or a decision record updated if behavior or a design decision changed
- [ ] No secrets or personal data in the diff
